query:
SELECT cardId, snkrdunkId, LENGTH(listings) as listings_length, hotExpiresAt, expiresAt, createdAt, updatedAt 
FROM snkrdunkListingsCache 
WHERE cardId = 781620 
ORDER BY createdAt DESC 
LIMIT 1;
